title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 3.1 Functions and Function Notation: Determine whether a relation represents a function.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 3.1 Functions and Function Notation: Determine whether a relation represents a function.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "3.1 Functions and Function Notation", prints these objectives: "Determine whether a relation represents a function." "Find the value of a function." "Determine whether a function is one-to-one." "Use the vertical line test to identify functions." "Graph the functions listed in the library of functions.". The section text says: "A jetliner changes altitude as its distance from the starting point of a flight increases. The weight of a growing child increases with time. In each case, one quantity depends on another. There is a relationship between the two quantities that we can describe, analyze, and use to make predictions. In this section, we will analyze such relationships." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
